final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT s.transref AS c1, t.ordertypedist AS c2, AVG(s.instownpct) AS c3 FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist), s2 AS (SELECT c2 AS m, AVG(c3) AS a FROM s1 GROUP BY c2), s3 AS (SELECT s1.c1 AS c1, s1.c2 AS c2, s1.c3 AS c3, s1.c3 / s2.a AS c4 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.c2 = s2.m), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(c3) AS a FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.c1, s3.c2, s3.c3, s3.c4, s3.c3 - s4.a AS c5 FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.c3 > s4.a) SELECT AVG(c3) AS avg_c3, AVG(c4) AS avg_c4, AVG(c5) AS avg_c5 FROM s5
